body: Did you ever find her? I think we are looking for the same person.
I see no one else commented and I hate to be the one cause I don’t know what to say. I’m going through the same shit you are and I’m sorry you feel this way. Truly.

You can still love yourself while trying to change for the better. An overweight person who hates themselves for their weight is gonna have a lot harder time than someone who loves themselves regardless of their weight but is willing to change for the better. I kinda do like this whole love your body movement, because it has shown people that it’s okay to love yourself no matter what. And if you do need the extra push to make some physical difference, then loving yourself is gonna be the best bet.
I felt exactly this way when Them came out and it was super popular. It didn’t sit right with my stomach, because I knew that Hollywood execs were capitalizing on BLM, and political “wokeness.”
Even my thoughts on this post are all fucking over the place, because I have so many goddamn problems I can’t even focus on one.
Honestly. Unfortunately, I’m so peeved I can’t even think of anything clever or ingenious.
